scenes.text: Myth or fact? In Korea, you take your shoes off everywhere.
scenes.quote: You take your shoes off everywhere in Korea.

scenes.text: Only in homes, at some temples, and in restaurants where you sit on the floor. Shops and offices, keep them on.
scenes.head: Not everywhere.

scenes.text: See a step up or a shoe shelf at the door? Shoes off.
scenes.rule: See a shoe shelf? Shoes off.

scenes.text: Send this to whoever's coming to Korea with you. Follow for more.
scenes.cta: Send this to your travel buddy.

caption:
Shoes off everywhere in Korea? Myth. 👟
Only in homes, at some temples, and in restaurants with floor seating. See a step up or a shoe shelf at the door? Shoes off.
Send this to whoever's coming to Korea with you.
Dari launches 25 Nov. Waitlist in bio.
